Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and wood and metal construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Pine Cone Detail
Pine cone details add texture among the festive foliage. Their recognisable shapes help create a woodland inspired arrangement, making the decoration easy to coordinate with other natural looking Christmas accessories.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

0810203490740.sourceDescription: Fill your tree with dozens of one-of-a-kind designs using Sleetly DIY White Christmas Baubles. This bulk set of 24 matte white baubles to paint gives crafters, hobbyists, and families plenty of blanks for big holiday projects, handmade gifts, and party favors. Each round bauble measures 2.36 inches (60mm) wide, a compact, smooth canvas that takes acrylic paint, paint markers, adhesive vinyl, stickers, glue, glitter, and beads with ease. The smaller size is perfect for mini baubles, advent countdowns, place-setting name tags, and packing a tree with variety. The matte finish grips color evenly with no slick glare, so painted designs turn out bold, crisp, and professional. Unlike fragile glass, these plastic bauble baubles are shatterproof, so they won't crack if dropped during crafting, gifting, or storage, making them ideal for group projects, craft fairs, and busy tables. Every blank bauble comes fitted with an upgraded metal cap and ribbon hanger, so your finished design is ready to hang the moment the paint dries. Paint your own snowman, monogram a family name, or create matching sets year after year. These paintable white blanks are great for holiday craft nights, DIY bauble kits, and personalized tree decor. Combine with other Sleetly colors, sizes and styles to expand your collection, or add more sets to build the fullness you want on your tree. From plain white blanks to painted showpieces, Sleetly makes DIY Christmas crafting simple, safe, and fun.

Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Glitter Finish
The glitter finish adds a light catching detail to the surface. It brings a more textured appearance to the decorative arrangement and pairs well with plain finishes when you want the smaller design elements to remain visible.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Clear plastic design pairs well with plain finishes to keep smaller elements visible.
Hanging format allows ornaments to be spread through branches or combined in displays.
Includes 20 baubles per pack for coordinated seasonal arrangement on your tree.
Guarantee - 1 month

Bring a soft, understated look to the tree with this 15 pack of velvet baubles. The set mixes green, brown and neutral tones, so the pieces can be grouped together or spread evenly for a balanced, minimalist display that suits both modern and traditional schemes.

Hang them on the tree, on wreaths, along a banister, above the fireplace or mixed into garlands. They also suit weddings, engagements, anniversaries and parties, or make a thoughtful gift for someone dressing their first home for Christmas. Because the palette is deliberately restrained, the baubles sit comfortably with brown, green and natural linen pieces you already own. Split the fifteen between rooms if you want the same quiet look running through the flat, or keep them together on one tree for a fuller effect.

8956086439840.sourceDescription:
A gold sequin tree skirt, 90 cm across, on a velvet base. It throws light around the base of the tree in a way that plain fabric cannot, especially with warm white bulbs.

The velvet is soft and the sequins are stitched in a dense pattern, so the skirt holds its shape when draped. Hand wash or a cold machine cycle, then dry flat away from radiators.

Gold works with red, green, cream and almost any bauble you already own.

Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

A colour matched concealed zip runs along one edge, so the pad slides in easily and the cover sits flat and neat once closed, with no visible stitching across the front. The red tree design is printed to hold its detail through the season, and the fabric resists bleeding, fading and fraying, so the covers can be used outdoors as well as indoors. High temperature cutting seals the edges cleanly so the seams hold up to regular use.

Care is simple. Machine wash the covers in cold water on a gentle cycle, separately from other laundry, and do not bleach. They keep their shape and colour wash after wash, with no shrinking. Tumble dry on low and do not iron.

Mix them with plain or patterned cushions on living room sofas, dining chairs, beds or an office chair, and bring them out again each December for an easy seasonal change. The pair also works well in a hallway, on a window seat or in a spare bedroom that needs a touch of Christmas colour.

5056903229340.sourceDescription:
Bring decorative colour, sparkle and seasonal detail to Christmas displays with this set of 12 silver artificial eucalyptus with maple leaf picks, each measuring 17 cm. Designed with glittered eucalyptus with maple-style leaves and flexible wired stems, these decorative pick stems can be bent and shaped to suit different arrangements and display styles. They are perfect decorative accents for fuller arrangement showcases. They can also be arranged around wreaths and garlands, placed in vases and centrepieces, or incorporated into bouquets, mantel displays and other festive floral arrangements. The glittered leaves provide added colour, texture and sparkle, helping to introduce a decorative finish to seasonal displays. The wired stems make positioning easier, allowing the picks to be attached anywhere in floral arrangements and other decorative elements. Suitable for Christmas trees, wreaths, garlands, vases, table centrepieces, bouquets, gift displays and DIY craft projects, these artificial eucalyptus with maple leaf picks can be used as standalone decorative accents or combined with other Christmas decorations and floral pieces. The silver colour can be incorporated into a range of festive decorating themes, from traditional seasonal arrangements to more coordinated displays. With a 17cm stem length and 12-piece quantity, this set provides flexible options for decorating different areas around the home, festive event spaces, or floral craft projects.
EUCALYPTUS WITH MAPLE LEAF PICKS SILVER 12 PCS 17 CM: Includes 12 silver glitter eucalyptus with maple leaf picks measuring 17 cm, featuring decorative leaves and flexible wired stems for arranging on Christmas trees, wreaths, garlands, vases, centrepieces, bouquets and festive floral displays

5071948819240.sourceDescription:
Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and fabric construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Pine Cone Detail
Pine cone details add texture among the festive foliage. Their recognisable shapes help create a woodland inspired arrangement, making the decoration easy to coordinate with other natural looking Christmas accessories.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Fabric. Colour: Green. Quantity: 1 piece.
Festive pine cone details add texture and a woodland-inspired charm to your Christmas display.
Lightweight fabric construction makes the wreath easy to handle, move, and store between seasons.
Versatile green design serves as an ideal focal point for indoor or outdoor holiday decorations.
Includes one piece of durable fabric wreath, ready to enhance your seasonal home styling.
Comes with 1 x Christmas Wreath

Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. Its green finish is easy to coordinate with the surrounding setting.

Pine Cone Detail
Pine cone details add texture among the festive foliage. Their recognisable shapes help create a woodland inspired arrangement, making the decoration easy to coordinate with other natural looking Christmas accessories.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Christmas Garland
This Christmas garland adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Metal. Product measurements: length 55 cm, width 6 cm. Quantity: 2 pack.
Reusable design allows for repeated festive use with simple care and storage between occasions.
Pack of two metal garlands provides ample decorative detail for creating focal points in your display.
Flexible hanging decoration can be easily repositioned to refresh the look of any arrangement.
Designed specifically for Christmas at home, adding a festive touch to indoor displays.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor & outdoor use
Included: 2x Christmas garlands

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

5059442204540.variantName: Blue Spruce Pot Grown Christmas Tree - Real Live Fresh Living Potted Plant - 4ft (120cm) · 本规格 / Selected: 4ft
5059442204540.sourceDescription:
Bring a living tree into your home for Christmas and enjoy the character that comes with choosing a pot-grown Blue Spruce. Its dense blue-green foliage and naturally conical shape create a full, well-balanced tree, while the slightly more rigid needles help the branches hold their shape beneath heavy lights and decorations. The unusual colouring sets it apart from other varieties, giving this real Christmas tree a distinctive appearance without needing to overdo the decorations.
DISTINCTIVE BLUE SPRUCE: Blue-green foliage and dense branching give this tree its characteristic appearance, with a naturally conical shape that looks full and well balanced. It also makes an attractive outdoor Christmas tree once the festive season has finished.
WHY CHOOSE POT-GROWN CHRISTMAS TREES?: This tree has been grown in its pot from the beginning, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container shortly before sale. Its roots have had time to develop within the pot as the tree has grown, without the disturbance of being dug up and moved. This makes it better suited to continuing its growth after Christmas, with a more established root system already growing in the pot. Unlike potted Christmas trees that have only recently been transferred from the ground, it can be kept outdoors and grown on after the festive season.
NEEDLES THAT HOLD WELL: Blue Spruce is known for its good needle retention, helping it maintain a full, fresh appearance throughout the Christmas period. This makes it a practical option for enjoying a real tree indoors without the rapid needle drop associated with some varieties.
YEAR-ROUND EVERGREEN TREES FOR GARDEN STRUCTURE: Blue Spruce keeps its blue-green foliage throughout the year, so its interest doesn't end when the Christmas decorations come down. Its evergreen character can add structure and colour to an outdoor space through every season.
CARE FOR YOUR LIVE POTTED CHRISTMAS TREES: Keep the compost moist while the tree is indoors, but avoid leaving it sitting in excess water. Position it away from radiators, fires, and other direct sources of heat, and keep its time indoors to the festive period rather than treating it like a permanent houseplant.
Please Note: Our pot grown trees are measured from the base of the pot to the tip of the tree.
Manufacturer guarantee: Statutory
